brief.title: Build the cost ledger
brief.plain_summary: Turn supplied usage exports and invoices into a ledger with one line per service and unit, keeping billed, measured, estimated and credit apart.
brief.outcome: A private cost ledger with unknown amounts left null.

usage_exports.description: Pins of usage exports or invoices the requester supplied.

repo_profile.description: Optional pin of a repository profile, to map costs to components.
